eyebrow: The sentence this project exists to produce
code:
ACTIVE MEMBER on day D =
  member has >= 1 membership row
  with status = 'active' on D,

  MINUS any day covered by an
  approved pause,

  counted ONCE even if active
  at two locations.
caption: Written once in int_active_members -- Finance, Marketing, and Product all query the same answer.
